Application Data.NAME: Toys Galore Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Toys Galore Inc. specializes in the retail of a wide range of toys, including educational toys, action figures, dolls, and games. Our business focuses on providing high-quality, safe, and age-appropriate toys for children of all ages. We maintain an extensive inventory, which is regularly monitored to ensure compliance with safety standards and to prevent any recalled or unsafe toys from being sold. Our operations are especially active during the holiday season, where we experience significant increases in sales. We have implemented robust inventory tracking systems and secure storage solutions to protect our merchandise against theft, damage, and loss. Additionally, we offer an online shopping platform to enhance customer accessibility, ensuring we can effectively serve our community and meet the growing demands of online shopping.

Underwriting Guidelines:
• Inventory Risks: Theft, damage, or loss of inventory due to fire, water damage, or misman-
agement can cause significant financial loss. Accurate inventory tracking and secure storage
are critical.
• Seasonality and Business Interruption: Toy stores often experience seasonal sales spikes
(e.g., holidays), increasing exposure to business interruption losses if a covered event disrupts
operations during peak periods.
Industry-Specific Restrictions
• No Recalled or Unsafe Toys: Underwriters must verify that no recalled, banned, or
unsafe toys are stocked or sold. This includes toys that fail to meet Consumer Product Safety
Commission (CPSC) standards or contain hazardous materials such as lead paint or small
detachable parts posing choking hazards.
• Cyber Coverage Tied to Online Presence: Cyber liability coverage is generally only
offered if the toy store maintains an active online presence, such as an e-commerce website
